attacks.name: Savage Slash
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, if |!damage| was dealt, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.
|!wild| |*Leap|: Before |!damage| is dealt, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.

attacks.name: Lethal Lycanthrope
steps: After this attack is resolved, if the target character is Size 3 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_small|.
|!hit| |*Curse of the Wolf|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| and |§hex§Hex| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Pounce
superPowers.body: Throw this character |!range_small|. It does not suffer |!damage| if it collides with another character or terrain feature. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Unearthly Howl
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character. Roll 4 dice. The chosen character loses |!power| equal to the number of |!critical|, |!wild|, and |!hit| results. Additionally, for each |!failure| rolled, the chosen character gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§slow§Slow| or |§root§Root|. A character can be affected by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Midnight Massacre
superPowers.body: After an attack against this character is resolved, it may use this superpower. If the attacker is within |!range| 3, this character may make a |*Savage Slash| attack targeting the attacker. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.
